title: AS2 code formatter and AST walker
description: Build packages/core/src/as2/formatter.ts: format(ast: Program, options?): string that pretty-prints an AS2 AST back to source with consistent indentation (2 spaces), semicolons, spacing. Also build packages/core/src/as2/walker.ts: walk(ast: Node, visitor: Visitor) depth-first traversal with enter/exit callbacks for each node type. Used by analysis tools and the Actions panel. Export from as2/index.ts. No UI.
